annotations.title: A written scout of one team

description: Writes the Desk's scout of one team it covers: its ranked reads of who matters and how the lines go, each with its evidence. Call it when someone asks for a scout, a breakdown of a team, or how to beat a named team. Pass `team`, a team the Desk covers, by name or Desk page link. Never call it for a whole club, because a scout is of one team. Needs a Desk Pass. Without one, a call gets the free part, with no chance in it, and `deskPass`, whose `message` you give the person.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

team.description: The team to scout, e.g. 'Belvedere 18AM3.5A', or its Desk page link or number.
